answer: Coordination-Weighted Action Ledger: each identity's influence scales with its history of actions that only pay off when other identities act independently. A vote counts fully only when preceded by a distinct, hard-to-fake contribution traceable to a separate origin, like a crystal forming under its own conditions. Each identity must periodically submit a marble—a costly, verifiable artifact of independent work—or its weight decays; colluding clones produce identical relics and cancel out.
